metadata.title: आदिवासी ज़िले में कलेक्टरी कितनी मुश्किल | मिताली सेठी | Mittali Sethi Interview
metadata.description:
In this powerful conversation with Main Bhi Bharat Editor Shyam Sunder, Dr Mittali Sethi — District Collector of Nandurbar, Maharashtra — talks about her journey, her work, and her deep engagement with one of the country’s most under-served tribal regions.

Yes, she made headlines for enrolling her own children in a Zilla Parishad Anganwadi / government school, a symbolic act meant to build trust in public institutions and challenge stereotypes about government education. But in this interview, Dr Sethi goes far beyond the headlines.
